content.text: TURN ASSEMBLY OVER AND REMOVE SET BOLTS FROM LOWER VALVE BODY

content.description: Illustration showing a hand turning over the valve body assembly to access bolts on the lower valve body

content.text: LIFT OFF LOWER VALVE BODY AND PLATE AS SINGLE UNIT
Hold valve body plate to lower valve body.
Be careful that the check valve and balls do not fall out.

content.description: Illustration showing hands lifting the lower valve body and plate assembly as a single unit

content.text: WATCH FOR STEEL BALLS, RETAINERS AND PINS IN VALVE BODY

content.description: Cross-sectional view of valve body showing locations of pins and retainers in internal passages
Top-down view of valve body plate showing internal passages with steel balls, retainers, and pins labeled
